claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_caster_turn_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: Blink fires 'at the end of each of your turns' — a turn-end trigger on the caster. OngoingTrigger has on_caster_turn_start and on_attached_turn_start but no turn-end counterparts. The distinction is mechanically meaningful: turn-end fires after the creature's last action, turn-start fires before the first.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: random_table in OngoingEffect
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The d6 roll with threshold outcome (4-6 = transport, 1-3 = nothing) is a random table resolved inside an ongoing operation. OngoingEffect supports save_gate, attack_roll, ability_check_gate, and EffectAtom variants, but not a random_table variant. The random_table phase shape exists on ActivationPhase but is not carried into OngoingEffect.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration. On a roll of 4-6, you vanish from your current plane of existence and appear in the Ethereal Plane.

claude_proposed_widenings.name: on_attached_turn_end
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: For symmetry and future coverage, the turn-end trigger family should include on_attached_turn_end (parallel to on_attached_turn_start). Blink's self-attachment means on_caster_turn_end covers this specific case, but the general gap affects any self/target-attached ongoing effect that fires at turn end.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Roll 1d6 at the end of each of your turns for the duration.
